thesis: The episode introduces Adam Mead, the author of the 800-page book The Complete Financial History of Berkshire Hathaway, and discusses his background as a small business owner who began investing around age 17. Mead explains that he wrote the book chronologically to provide a detailed history of the company that he felt was missing, noting that it took him five years to complete and that he initially planned to self-publish before finding a publisher.
